## `scripts/ui/city_hud.gd`

class_name `CityHud` · extends `CanvasLayer`

SimCity-style HUD for GridFall: city vitals and RCI demand, time controls, player powers (overlays, disasters, decrees, grants, ordinance overrides), the five AI mayor cards, and panels for mayor minds, the Gazette, City Hall, the street inspector, the GMI call log and the city feed.

## `scripts/ui/gridfall_hud.gd`

class_name `GridFallHud` · extends `CanvasLayer`

SimCity-Style Civic & Multi-Agent Growth HUD for GridFall: - Top Civic Bar: City Day/Phase, Population, 5 SimCity Vital Bars (⚡ Power, 🚰 Sewage/Water, 🚗 Traffic, 🌿 Sanitation, 😊 Happiness), Playback controls, HY-Image 3.5 Lookbook button, and ACE-Step 1.5 status. - Interactive Emergency Toolbar: Trigger [🚰 Sewage Burst], [🚗 Traffic Jam], [⚡ Grid Blackout], [🌫️ Smog Spike], or [✅ Restore] live and pan camera. - Bottom AI Mayor Dock: 5 compact SimCity Mayor cards showing Treasury ($), Daily Income, Buildings Built, Approval %, and Today's Construction. - Right Collapsible Inspector Drawer: Switch between "🧠 Selected Agent Mind & Growth Portfolio" and "📡 All-Model Public vs. Private Thought Stream".

### Signals

- `toggle_play_requested()`
- `step_next_requested()`
- `step_prev_requested()`
- `focus_resident_requested(resident_id: String)`
- `focus_landmark_requested(landmark_key: String)`
- `trigger_problem_requested(problem_kind: String)`
